breakpoint.$description: Min-widths for mobile-first media queries. CSS variables can't be read inside @media, so use the SCSS or JS export, or the literal value.

md.$description: Large phones in landscape, small tablets, narrow windows.

lg.$description: Tablets in landscape, laptops. The side navigation shows inline from here.

columns.$description: Columns in the page grid: 4 below md, 8 from md, 12 from lg.

margin.$description: Inline padding between the viewport edge and page content.

gutter.$description: Gap between grid columns, and between cards laid out on the grid.

section-gap.$description: Vertical space between the major sections of a page.

header-height.$description: Height of the app's top bar. Use it for sticky offsets and scroll-padding-top.

sidebar-width.$description: Width of the side navigation when it shows inline (lg and up).

prose.$description: Longest comfortable line for running text: articles, descriptions, help.

page.$description: Default max width for page content. Data-heavy screens may go full width.
